description: This file provides utility functions to determine the host machine's architecture and check compatibility, using system calls and string comparisons.

methods.name: HostArchStr
methods.description: Returns a string representing the host architecture, such as 'aarch64' or 'x86_64'.

methods.name: HostArch
methods.description: Determines the architecture enum based on the string returned by HostArchStr.

methods.name: IsHostCompatible
methods.description: Checks if a given architecture is compatible with the host's architecture.
